What counts as hopecore?

This is vocabulary bingo, not a verdict on the ideas. Squares match words and related forms, including hyphen variants. A mention still counts when it is critical, ironic or negated. Click any square to see the evidence and its reference.

The centre is free. Five marked squares in a row, column or diagonal make bingo. The count measures vocabulary overlap, not meaning or quality.

The reference shelf

Our reading of a recognisable register: speculative design meets futures workshops, relational thinking and ecological care. The sources have distinct arguments; the parody mixes their vocabulary.
